input.subject: FW: Bagged Rice Orders for Africa
input.body:
-----Original Message-----
From: PNA Shipbrokers - Singapore <pna@pnaship.com> 
Sent: Wednesday, 6 May 2026 05:29
To: pna@pnaship.com
Subject: Bagged Rice Orders for Africa



FROM: PACIFIC & ATLANTIC SHIPBROKERS - SINGAPORE / (Email/Teams:
pna@pnaship.com)

**

Pls offer best with named tng / full itin.

- NO FRT IDEAS FM CHRS. SEEKING OWS BEST 

aa)
- 20000/25000 mt bgd rice 50 kgs pp bags 
- kakinada anchorage, ec india  / monrovia, west africa (10m sw)
- 2000mt load / 1500mt disch - pwwd sat12pm/mon08am ntc eiu
- laycan 10-15 may
- 5pct on f/d/d/d

* max age 20yrs
* frt bss free da at lport and disport 
* dunnage on charterers acct.

+++++++ 

bb)
- 30,000 mt 10% moloo rice in 50 kgs bags (sf abt 1.4 cbm/mt wog) 
- kakinada anch, ec india / conakary, west africa (10m sw)
- laycan ppt/07 may (try vsl dates) 
- 2000mt load / 2000mt disch - pwwd sat12pm/mon08am ntc eiu (all holds at
both lports)
- 5pct on f/d/d/d

* charts can do free da at lport and disport 
* dunnage on charterers acct.

+++++++

cc)
- 25000/35000 mt bgd rice in 50 kg bags (sf abt 1.4 cbm/mt wog)
- dhamra, ec india / durban, south africa 
- laycan 25-30 may
- load rate 500 mt/hook/day shex eiu
- disrate 400 mt/hook/day shex eiu
- 5pct on f/d/d/d

+++++++ 

dd)
- 30,000 mt 10% rice in bags (max draft at dsch port 10.00m)
- kosichang (10,000 mt) + kakinada anchorage (balance)
- dssch port conakary, guinea
- laycan prompt / onw (try vsl dates)
- 2000mt load / 2000mt disch - pwwd sat12pm/mon08am ntc eiu bends 
- all holds at both lports
- 5pct on f/d/d/d

* charts can do free da at lport and disport 
* dunnage on charterers acct.

end>> 


B Rgds 
Tony (TEAMS: pna@pnaship.com)





-- 
This email has been checked for viruses by AVG antivirus software.
www.avg.com
